recommended_command.docker_command:
docker run --gpus all \
  --privileged --ipc=host -p 8000:8000 \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  vllm/vllm-openai:latest Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --distributed_executor_backend mp \
  --async-scheduling \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --quantization ascend

guide:
## Overview

Qwen3-30B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model in the Qwen3 series, featuring 30.5B total parameters with 3.3B activated per token. The sparse MoE architecture enables efficient training and inference, delivering strong performance across reasoning, instruction-following, and agent capabilities.

First supported in vLLM-Ascend v0.8.4rc2. This guide is validated on **vLLM-Ascend v0.22.1rc**. All v0.22.1rc and later versions can run stably.

## Prerequisites

- **Hardware**: Atlas 800I A3 (64G, 1-2 cards) or Atlas 800I A2 (64G, 2-4 cards)
- **Model weights**: Download from [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B) (BF16) or [Eco-Tech](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3-30B-A3B-w8a8) (W8A8)
- **Eagle3 draft model** (optional): Download from [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/AngelSlim/Qwen3-a3B_eagle3)

### Environment Setup

**Docker (recommended):**
```bash
docker pull quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:latest
```

**Pip install:**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git
cd vllm && pip install -e .
git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend.git
cd vllm-ascend && pip install -e .
```

## Quantization

Qwen3-30B-A3B-W8A8 uses hybrid quantization:
- Embedding/QK normalization: BF16
- Attention projections: Static W8A8 with per-tensor scales
- MoE routing gate: BF16
- MoE expert projections: Dynamic W8A8 (input scales computed on-the-fly)

## Service Verification

After starting the service, verify with:
```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "model": "qwen3",
        "messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "Give me a short introduction to large language models."}
        ],
        "temperature": 0.6,
        "top_p": 0.95,
        "max_completion_tokens": 4096
    }'
```

## Accuracy Results (Atlas 800I A3, W8A8)

| Dataset       | Metric                | Score  |
| ------------- | --------------------- | ------ |
| GSM8K         | accuracy (4-shot CoT) | 92.87% |
| GPQA-Diamond  | accuracy (0-shot CoT) | 60.10% |
| LiveCodeBench | pass@1 (0-shot)       | 60.05% |
| AIME 2024     | accuracy (0-shot)     | 76.67% |

## Recommended Configurations

| Scenario        | NPUs   | TP  | max-model-len | max-num-seqs | EP  |
| --------------- | ------ | --- | ------------- | ------------ | --- |
| High Throughput | 1 (A3) | 1   | 37364         | 100          | Off |
| Low Latency     | 2 (A3) | 4   | 37364         | 100          | On  |
| Long Context    | 2 (A3) | 4   | 131072        | 14           | On  |

## Troubleshooting

Refer to [Performance Tuning Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/developer_guide/performance_and_debug/optimization_and_tuning.html) and [FAQ](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html).

## References

- [ModelScope (BF16)](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B)
- [ModelScope (W8A8)](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3-30B-A3B-w8a8)
- [Eagle3 Draft Model](https://huggingface.co/AngelSlim/Qwen3-a3B_eagle3)

guide_zh:
## 概述

Qwen3-30B-A3B 是 Qwen3 系列的混合专家 (MoE) 模型，拥有 30.5B 总参数和 3.3B 激活参数。稀疏 MoE 架构实现了高效的训练和推理。

首次支持于 vLLM-Ascend v0.8.4rc2。本文档基于 **vLLM-Ascend v0.22.1rc** 验证编写，所有 v0.22.1rc 及之后版本均可稳定运行。

## 环境准备

- **硬件**: Atlas 800I A3 (64G, 1-2 卡) 或 Atlas 800I A2 (64G, 2-4 卡)
- **模型权重**: 从 [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B) (BF16) 或 [Eco-Tech](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/Qwen3-30B-A3B-w8a8) (W8A8) 下载
- **Eagle3 草稿模型** (可选): [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/AngelSlim/Qwen3-a3B_eagle3)

### 环境搭建

**Docker (推荐):**
```bash
docker pull quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:latest
```

**Pip 安装:**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git
cd vllm && pip install -e .
git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend.git
cd vllm-ascend && pip install -e .
```

## 量化方案

Qwen3-30B-A3B-W8A8 采用混合量化：Embedding/QK Norm 保持 BF16；Attention 投影使用静态 W8A8；MoE 门控保持 BF16；MoE 专家投影使用动态 W8A8。

## 服务验证

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "model": "qwen3",
        "messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "简单介绍一下大语言模型。"}
        ],
        "temperature": 0.6,
        "max_completion_tokens": 4096
    }'
```

## 精度结果 (Atlas 800I A3, W8A8)

| 数据集        | 指标                  | 得分   |
| ------------- | --------------------- | ------ |
| GSM8K         | accuracy (4-shot CoT) | 92.87% |
| GPQA-Diamond  | accuracy (0-shot CoT) | 60.10% |
| LiveCodeBench | pass@1 (0-shot)       | 60.05% |
| AIME 2024     | accuracy (0-shot)     | 76.67% |

## 推荐配置

| 场景       | NPU 数量 | TP  | max-model-len | max-num-seqs | EP  |
| ---------- | -------- | --- | ------------- | ------------ | --- |
| 高吞吐     | 1 (A3)   | 1   | 37364         | 100          | 关闭 |
| 低延迟     | 2 (A3)   | 4   | 37364         | 100          | 开启 |
| 长上下文   | 2 (A3)   | 4   | 131072        | 14           | 开启 |

## 故障排除

参考 [性能调优指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/developer_guide/performance_and_debug/optimization_and_tuning.html) 和 [常见问题](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html)。
